posts.description: There are fundamental skills that define how our life unfolds, our responses, success, wellbeing and happiness. They correspond to three primary centers of the brain; sensory, emotional and together; memory, thought and imagination—thought, feeling and action.

posts.title: History’s View of this 250th Celebration
posts.description: David Bohm, one of the most original, quietly revolutionary physicists of the 20th century, was indeed a rare privilege. David pushed far beyond the boundaries of conventional science. What made him unique wasn’t just what he discovered, but how he thought.

posts.title: The Betrayal of Intimacy
posts.description: For the developing fetus, newborn, infant and pre-adolescent child, intimacy is affectionate touch, soothing safety, embodied and pleasurable sensations that define basic trust. Building on reciprocal pleasure and basic trust this developmental foundation fulfills nature’s sexual passion for pair-bonding, reproduction, and later the nurturing of children.
